{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Re-check for QA orders in the full dataset
qa_orders_full = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Total QA orders in full dataset: {len(qa_orders_full)}")

# Now check if any QA orders are in the loyal_completed group
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]
qa_in_loyal = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"QA orders in loyal completed group: {len(qa_in_loyal)}")

# Inspect one QA order
if len(qa_in_loyal) > 0:
    print(qa_in_loyal.iloc[0])

# Remove QA orders from loyal_completed
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float
loyal_completed_clean['revenue_float'] = loyal_completed_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue on clean data
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of loyal completed orders (clean): {len(loyal_completed_clean)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (clean, USD): {mean_revenue_clean:.2f}")"}
